name: Please Follow the Instructions
detailed_description:
Welcome to... somewhere. You're not quite sure where, or why. All you know is you're trapped in an isolated room, monitored by cameras, and guided by an omniscient voice that insists, with a perfectly placed hint of sarcasm, that you "follow the instructions."

Press the button. You're not sure why. But the voice seems to know. A screen flickers to life, presenting you with a labyrinth of puzzles that test not just your cognitive abilities, but the limits of your patience. Each room, each puzzle, is a step deeper into this bizarre journey. And the voice... oh, the voice always has something to say, whether it's a dry remark or a cryptic clue.

But be warned. What begins as a sarcastic experiment gradually transforms into a dark and unsettling drama. As you progress, you begin to ask questions. Who is the voice? Why are you here? And what lurks beyond the doors you open?

It's a narrative experience where you are both participant and witness. The choices you make, the puzzles you solve, will lead you down a path riddled with suspense, mystery, and an ending that will challenge your perception of reality.

Key Features:

  • Ingenious Puzzles: Each room is a new challenge, designed to test your logic and creativity.

  • Captivating Narrative: A story that unfolds as you progress, with twists and turns and an unexpected ending.

  • Omniscient Voice: A narrator that guides (or manipulates?) you with a blend of sarcasm and cryptic hints.

  • Tense Atmosphere: A world where suspense and mystery intertwine, creating an immersive gaming experience.

  • Tone Shift: From initial sarcasm to psychological drama, the game will keep you hooked until the very end.

Are you ready to follow the instructions?

short_description: Trapped in an isolated room, you're guided by a mysterious voice and monitored by cameras. Solve intricate puzzles to break free, but be warned: the initial sarcasm hides a dramatic and unsettling truth. Follow the instructions... if you dare.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 or AMD 6700-XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
